text: Square $ABCD$ has side length $2$. A semicircle with diameter $\overline{AB}$ is constructed inside the square, and the tangent to the semicircle from $C$ intersects side $\overline{AD}$ at $E$. What is the length of $\overline{CE}$?
figure: Square ABCD with A at the bottom left, B at the bottom right, C at the top right and D at the top left. A semicircle with diameter AB sits on the bottom side and bulges upward inside the square; it touches the left side AD at A and the right side BC at B. A straight segment starts at C, touches the semicircle once on its upper-left part, and ends at point E on the left side AD, with E between A and D and closer to A. No lengths are marked in the figure.
